name: Connecting Ridge
note: Proposed site on the Shackleton–de Gerlache connecting ridge (LPSC 2024). Near-continuous sunlight, Earth skims the horizon.
note_es: Sitio propuesto en la cresta que une Shackleton y de Gerlache (LPSC 2024). Luz solar casi continua; la Tierra roza el horizonte.

name: Connecting Ridge · Site B
note: Alternative point on the same ridge (ICES 2024). A few km shifts the dark periods.
note_es: Punto alternativo en la misma cresta (ICES 2024). Unos pocos km cambian los períodos de oscuridad.

name: Nobile Rim 2
note: Optimum point from a multi-criteria study of the Nobile Rim 2 region.
note_es: Punto óptimo de un estudio multicriterio de la región Nobile Rim 2.

name: Haworth
note: Haworth crater area. Deep crater floor, permanently shadowed; rim is the candidate zone.
note_es: Zona del cráter Haworth. Piso profundo, en sombra permanente; el borde es la zona candidata.

name: Malapert massif
note: A 5 km massif with a direct line of sight to Earth for most of the month.
note_es: Macizo de 5 km con línea de vista directa a la Tierra gran parte del mes.

name: Cabeus
note: LCROSS impact crater. Water ice detected; floor never sees the Sun.
note_es: Cráter del impacto LCROSS. Se detectó hielo de agua; el piso nunca ve el Sol.

name: IM-1 · Odysseus
note: Intuitive Machines IM-1, Feb 2024, near Malapert A. Tipped over on landing.
note_es: Intuitive Machines IM-1, feb 2024, cerca de Malapert A. Volcó al aterrizar.

name: IM-2 · Athena
note: Intuitive Machines IM-2, Mar 2025, Mons Mouton plateau.
note_es: Intuitive Machines IM-2, mar 2025, meseta de Mons Mouton.

name: Chandrayaan-3 · Shiv Shakti
note: ISRO, Aug 2023. Southernmost soft landing so far.
note_es: ISRO, ago 2023. El aterrizaje suave más austral hasta hoy.

name: Luna 25 (impact)
note: Roscosmos, Aug 2023. Failed descent near Pontécoulant G.
note_es: Roscosmos, ago 2023. Descenso fallido cerca de Pontécoulant G.

name: Chang'e 4
note: CNSA, Jan 2019. Far side, needs the Queqiao relay satellite: Earth is never visible.
note_es: CNSA, ene 2019. Cara oculta: necesita el satélite relé Queqiao, la Tierra nunca se ve.

name: Chang'e 6
note: CNSA, Jun 2024. Far side sample return.
note_es: CNSA, jun 2024. Retorno de muestras de la cara oculta.

name: Apollo 11
note: Tranquility Base, Jul 1969.
note_es: Base Tranquilidad, jul 1969.

name: Apollo 12
note: Oceanus Procellarum, Nov 1969.
note_es: Oceanus Procellarum, nov 1969.

name: Apollo 14
note: Fra Mauro, Feb 1971.
note_es: Fra Mauro, feb 1971.

name: Apollo 15
note: Hadley–Apennine, Jul 1971.
note_es: Hadley–Apeninos, jul 1971.

name: Apollo 16
note: Descartes highlands, Apr 1972.
note_es: Tierras altas de Descartes, abr 1972.

name: Apollo 17
note: Taurus–Littrow, Dec 1972.
note_es: Taurus–Littrow, dic 1972.

name: Chang'e 3
note: CNSA, Dec 2013. Mare Imbrium.
note_es: CNSA, dic 2013. Mare Imbrium.

name: Blue Ghost 1
note: Firefly, Mar 2025. Mare Crisium, a full lunar day of operation.
note_es: Firefly, mar 2025. Mare Crisium, un día lunar completo de operación.
